'''Ndyuka-Tiriyó Pidgin''' (Ndyuka-Trio) was a [[trade language]] used until the 1960s between speakers of [[Ndyuka language|Ndyuka]], an [[English-based creole]], and [[Tiriyó language|Tiriyó]] and [[Wayana language|Wayana]], both [[Cariban languages]].
